notes: This camp costs money. Check the page in spring for 2027 dates.
name: Young Filmmakers Camp (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
org: Marquee Arts (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
what_you_do: Learn to make films from working pros. Three weeks cover planning, filming and editing. The camp ends with a red carpet show of your films.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: $576.25 for session 1, $901.25 for session 2, $576.25 for session 3, or $1,901.25 for all sessions.
duration: 2026 dates: June 29 to July 3, July 6 to 10 and 13 to 15, and July 20 to 24
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed Friday, June 19, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates and prices are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online on the Film Camp page. Questions: Holly Behrend, hbehrend@marquee-arts.org.
